questions.stem: What is the atom economy for the production of hydrogen from Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl₂ + H₂? (Ar: Zn = 65, H = 1, Cl = 35.5)
questions.explanation: Atom economy = (Mr of desired product / sum of Mr of all reactants) × 100. Mr of H₂ = 2. Sum of Mr of reactants = 65 + 2(36.5) = 65 + 73 = 138. Atom economy = (2/138) × 100 = 1.4%. This is very low because most atoms end up in the by-product ZnCl₂.
